description: This file is a shell script for automating a complex build, setup, patching, and testing workflow for a C++ project involving multiple repositories and components such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, googletest, and entservices-appgateway. It includes steps for cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring and building components via CMake, copying plugins and headers, running tests, and generating code coverage reports.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages with a prefix to stdout.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks for the availability of a command in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the script is running with root privileges.

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get commands with proper privilege escalation.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs warnings if it fails, non-fatal.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to make Git commands non-interactive.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git reference or tag in a repository.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Ensures a repository is cloned and checked out at a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory, idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks whether a build directory has been configured via CMake.

methods.name: is_component_installed

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Runs CMake configure, build, and install steps for a component.
